title: HardUpgrade
description: This mod artificially slows down progress at the beginning of the game, creating additional difficulties for beginners. To overcome this barrier and become stronger, you must constantly improve your character
body:
# HardUpgrade
HardUpgrade is a progressive hardcore mod for Minecraft 1.20.1, which radically changes the approach to survival. Now your abilities are not given to you right away — you need to earn them by developing three key areas: Mining, Fighting and Walking.

-  Basic mechanics
At the beginning of the game, your character is weak and limited. To remove debuffs and increase performance, you need to accumulate experience points in the appropriate categories.

-  Mining
Progress: Each destruction of blocks (stone, ore) gives points.

Removing restrictions: Up to level 50, the effect of Mining Fatigue is applied to the player.

Power-ups: Every 5 levels, your base digging speed increases by 0.1.

-  Combat
Progress: Defeat hostile and peaceful mobs to level up.

Health: Your maximum HP depends on your combat level.

Levels 1-10: +2 HP (1 heart) per level.

Levels 11-50: +1 HP (0.5 hearts) per level.

🏃 Walking
Progress: Just explore the world. Each completed block brings you closer to a new level.

Removing restrictions: Up to level 50, the player is affected by the Slowness effect.

- Skill tree, for points received when leveling up
